# GET /api/v1/orgs/{org}/members

List an organization's members. If the doer is a member or admin, shows all members; otherwise shows only public members.

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-070`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — []*api.User

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | user ID |
| `login` | string | username |
| `full_name` | string | full name |
| `email` | string | email (may be placeholder if private) |
| `avatar_url` | string | avatar URL |
| `html_url` | string | profile URL |
| `created` | time | creation time |
| `restricted` | bool | is restricted user |
| `visibility` | string | user visibility |
| `followers_count` | int | follower count |
| `following_count` | int | following count |
| `starred_repos_count` | int | starred repos count |

- **404** — Organization does not exist

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Member list visibility: if doer is org member or admin, all members shown; otherwise only public members | authorization | ctx.Doer != nil && (isMember || ctx.Doer.IsAdmin) |
| Restricted users in org member list only see public members and their own teammates | business_logic | opts.Doer != nil && opts.IsDoerMember && opts.Doer.IsRestricted |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| GetOrgByName returns ErrOrgNotExist | 404 | notFound | False |
| IsOrgMember/CountOrgMembers/FindOrgMembers fails | 500 | internal error | True |

### Error Paths

- **Org not found** → orgAssignment → 404
- **DB error on IsOrgMember** → ListMembers → 500
- **DB error on CountOrgMembers/FindOrgMembers** → listMembers → 500
